comparison_to_8mib_stress_setting: diag2/DIAGNOSIS.md measured 2,127 row groups at batch_bytes=8MiB for a similar-sized (10,335-row) 1-month partition (~5 rows/row-group, ~0.24 MB/row-group footer growth -> projected ~5-6 GiB/year at that stress setting). At the PRODUCTION DEFAULT (256 MiB), this run produced only 71 row groups for 10,335 rows (~146 rows/row-group), footer_serialized_bytes=2.2 MB -- about a 30x reduction in row-group count at the setting the packet asked to evaluate.

full_year_projection.note: linear extrapolation only; a full 2022 year at this per-day row rate projects to roughly 12x this run's row-group count (~850) and file size (~2.1 GB) -- well inside an 8 GiB budget. Not independently re-measured at full-year scale.

verdict_row_group_feasibility: PASS: production default batch_bytes does not approach the 8 GiB budget via row-group metadata growth; no row-group coalescing implemented (not needed per the packet -- only required if the default setting demonstrably violated the budget).
